services.desc: Great experience with Inshore Extreme Fishing Charters. Next time I come to Myrtle Beach I will be going fishing with them. Thanks Capt. Rob! As stated in our review of our Jan 2013 trip" WE CAME BACK" to Rob and Extreme Charters. Nina (my great wife) more than once told me it is so beautiful out here. Then she commenced to out fished me again. Saw several dolphins together taking advantage of the fishing.. Sum it up we have fish in the frying pan and freezer. Again boat and equipment of high quality and very clean. Rob,, super nice and works to hard to make a day one to remember. In 2 weeks we are going back for our 3rd trip this year.
